Name: teleportStaff
Author: saltyfish0322
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][b]Main Purpose of the Mod: Teleportation Staff[/b]
This mod introduces a [b]Teleportation Staff[/b] to your game, a powerful tool that allows players to record specific locations and instantly teleport back to them at the cost of stamina (or a similar in-game resource). Perfect for fast travel, escaping danger, or optimizing exploration, this mod adds a strategic layer to movement while maintaining balance through resource consumption. [/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]Added a staff for teleportation, which can be upgraded at the blacksmith shop. The following are the stamina consumption and the number of coordinates that can be recorded[/color]
添加了一个用来传送的法杖，可以在铁匠铺进行升级，以下是体力消耗以及可记录的坐标个数
| 等级 | 消耗 | 可记录坐标个数 | 
| --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | 100 | 2 | 
| 1 | 80 | 3 | 
| 2 | 60 | 4 | 
| 3 | 40 | 5 |
| 4 | 20 | 6 | 
| 5 | 1 | 7 |

If you marry a player, you can teleport to their side
When teleporting, if the horse is nearby, it can be teleported together
如果跟玩家结婚，则可以传送到对方身边
传送时，如果马在附近，可以将马一起传送
